title: Applying Buffs and Debuffs Globally in RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: cozathemaster
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I'm working on a project in RPG Maker MZ and need help with applying buffs and debuffs in the damage calculation.
Problem:
Currently, RPG Maker MZ applies buffs and debuffs to the base attack value before applying the damage formula. This makes buffs and debuffs unpredictable for the player, as the final damage result depends on the enemy's defense. I would like buffs and debuffs to be applied to the final damage result so that they are easier to understand and predict.
Example:
For a basic attack, I use the formula: a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2.If a character applies a buff that increases damage by 200%, I want this buff to be applied to the final damage result. That is, if the attack did 100 damage, with the buff it should do 200 damage.
What I'm Looking For:
I want a method (preferably a plugin) that ensures any buff or debuff applied through states, skills, equipment is applied to the final damage result.
Any help or suggestions would be greatly appreciated. Thanks in advance!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
So...what is a "buff that increases damage"? There's no such thing in the editor.
You could have a buff that increases atk, or a buff that increases mat, but as you say that adjusts the parameter itself - there's no way to buff all damage.
Instead of using buffs, you should be applying a state and using a plugin that gives you ways to modify damage via notetags in the states.
You can use my Eval Tags, linked in my signature; or if you already have VisuStella plugins in your project, you can use their Battle Core.
With my Eval Tags, you'd give a state a notetag:
Code:
<Action Hit Eval>
if (skill.isDamage())
    value *= 2;
</Action Hit Eval>
That will cause all damage you do while you have that state to be doubled.

I followed your advice and found the way to achieve the desired effect trough the battle Core.
It was:

value *= 2;
</JS Pre-Damage as User>
